title: ETSI TS 119 602 V1.1.1 - List of Trusted Entities (LoTE), JSON binding
description: JSON Schema for a List of Trusted Entities derived from the data model of ETSI TS 119 602 V1.1.1 (2025-11), clauses 5 and 6 and Annexes A-C. Where the text is unambiguous the schema follows the text; where the text contradicts itself (mostly component names) property names follow the ETSI Forge JSON binding (esi/x19_60201_lists_of_trusted_entities). Signing (clause 6.8) is out of scope: in the JSON binding the LoTE is the payload of a compact JAdES Baseline B signature (ETSI TS 119 182-1).
$comment: Requirements of clauses 5-6 and Annex B that JSON Schema cannot express, to be enforced by a business-rules layer: 6.1.4 a Latin transliteration accompanies native terms that cannot be written in the Latin alphabet; 6.3.2 the sequence number starts at 1 and increases with every release; 6.3.6 the CC prefix of every SchemeName value equals SchemeTerritory, and the name is unique per operator; 6.3.13 one of the ServiceDigitalIdentities authenticates the pointed-to list; 6.3.15 NextUpdate lies after ListIssueDateTime, and a closed list (NextUpdate null) shows every service as expired; 6.4.0 TrustedEntitiesList is present exactly when an entity is or was approved; 6.4.4 ServiceHistory is in descending order of status change time; 6.6.0/6.6.3.0 a PKI-based service identity contains an X509Certificate (6.6.0) or an X509Certificate or X509SKI (6.6.3.0); 6.6.3.3 a PublicKeyValue is the key of the certificates in the same identity; 6.6.5 a StatusStartingTime is not before the list's (re)issuance; 6.7 a history identity covers the identifiers applicable in that period; 6.8.0 the signing certificate's C and O match SchemeTerritory and a SchemeOperatorName value; Annex B.2 7) multilingual strings contain no mark-up.

LoTE.description: Clause 5. A LoTE: list and scheme information plus, when any entity is or was approved, the trusted entities list.

if.description: Clause 6.6.0: when HistoricalInformationPeriod is present with a non-zero value, ServiceStatus shall be present.

LoTETag.description: Clauses 5 and 6.2. Character representation of the LoTE Tag URI. Required: clause 5 allows exactly one tag. Any URI is accepted, because the text registers no Tag URI value. The Annex A JSON schema has no tag property; the text prevails (A.1).

ListAndSchemeInformation.description: Clause 6.3 and Table 1. Implicit scheme information: only the LoTE-level elements. Explicit scheme information: any explicit-only element makes all explicit elements mandatory.

LoTEVersionIdentifier.description: Clause 6.3.1. Version of the LoTE format for this syntax binding. The text imposes no value (NOTE to 6.3.1); profiles in Annexes D-I require 1.

LoTESequenceNumber.description: Clause 6.3.2. Starts at 1 and is incremented at each release; never recycled.

LoTEType.description: Clause 6.3.3. LoTE type URI (registered values in Annex C.2.1).

SchemeOperatorName.description: Clause 6.3.4. Formal name of the scheme operator.

SchemeOperatorAddress.description: Clause 6.3.5. Postal and electronic address of the scheme operator.

SchemeName.description: Clause 6.3.6. Each value is 'CC:name_value', CC being the SchemeTerritory code; an English version is required.

SchemeInformationURI.description: Clause 6.3.7. Where scheme-specific information (and possibly archived versions of the list) can be obtained.

StatusDeterminationApproach.description: Clause 6.3.8. Status determination approach URI (registered values in Annex C.2.2).

SchemeTypeCommunityRules.description: Clause 6.3.9. Scheme type/community/rules URIs (registered values in Annex C.2.3).

SchemeTerritory.description: Clause 6.3.10. Country or territory code as per clause 6.1.5.

PolicyOrLegalNotice.description: Clause 6.3.11. Either a sequence of LoTEPolicy pointers or a sequence of LoTELegalNotice texts, not a mix; an English entry is required (clause 6.1.4).

HistoricalInformationPeriod.description: Clause 6.3.12. Retention period (a duration, hence not negative) of historical information; 65535 means never removed. Absent means history is not kept.

PointersToOtherLoTE.description: Clause 6.3.13. Pointers to other relevant LoTEs or lists of LoTEs.

LoTELocation.description: URI of the machine processable form of the other LoTE.

ServiceDigitalIdentities.description: Digital identities of the issuer of the pointed-to LoTE.

LoTEQualifier.description: Clause 6.3.13 c): LoTE type, scheme operator name, optional scheme type/community/rules, scheme territory and MIME type.

ListIssueDateTime.description: Clause 6.3.14. UTC date-time at which the LoTE was issued.

NextUpdate.description: Clause 6.3.15. UTC date-time by which the next update will be issued, or null for a closed LoTE.

DistributionPoints.description: Clause 6.3.16. Locations where the current LoTE is published.

SchemeExtensions.description: Clause 6.3.17. Scheme extensions; format is open but each shall indicate its criticality.

TrustedEntitiesList.description: Clause 6.4. Present only if one or more entities are or were approved under the scheme.

ServiceHistory.description: Clause 6.4.4. Previous statuses in descending order of status change date-time.

TEName.description: Clause 6.5.1. Name used in formal legal registrations.

TETradeName.description: Clause 6.5.2. Official registration identifier and/or trade name.

ServiceDigitalIdentity.description: Clause 6.6.3. One or more digital identifiers of the service.

X509Certificates.description: Clause 6.6.3.1: 'The X509Certificate component shall be a Base64 string' holding a Base64 encoded X.509 certificate.

X509SubjectNames.description: Clause 6.6.3.2. Distinguished Names as strings (RFC 4514 recommended).

PublicKeyValues.description: Clause 6.6.3.3: 'The format of the PublicKeyValue component is left open and is syntax-specific.' The text defines no JSON format, so values are not constrained.

X509SKIs.description: Clause 6.6.3.4 (subject key identifier): its Format paragraph repeats 6.6.3.3, 'left open and is syntax-specific', so values are not constrained.

OtherIds.description: Clause 6.6.3.5: 'The format of the OtherId component is left open.'

StatusStartingTime.description: Clause 6.6.5. UTC date-time at which the current status became effective.

SchemeServiceDefinitionURI.description: Clause 6.6.6. Service information provided by the scheme operator.

ServiceSupplyPoints.description: Clause 6.6.7. URIs where the service can be accessed, each optionally typed by a URI.

ServiceDefinitionURI.description: Clause 6.6.8 (TE service definition URI). Service information provided by the TE.

PostalAddresses.description: Clause 6.3.5.1. Postal address in one or more languages; an English version is required (clause 6.1.4).

Country.description: Clause 6.3.5.1: 'a two-character code in accordance with clause 6.1.5 (a)', i.e. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 with UK instead of GB, EL instead of GR, and EU.

ElectronicAddress.description: Clause 6.3.5.2. Mandatory e-mail (mailto:, RFC 2368) and web-site URIs, optional telephone (tel:) URI; an English entry is required (clause 6.1.4). The web-site is taken to be an http(s) URI.

Extension.description: Extension whose format is left open. 'Critical' has the X.509 extension semantics: a critical extension that is not recognized causes the LoTE to be rejected.

MultiLangString.description: Clause 6.1.4 and Annex B.2. Language-tagged plain text.

MultiLangStrings.description: Clause 6.1.4: a sequence of multilingual character strings; lists 'shall be issued supporting at least the UK English language', so an 'en' entry is required.

MultiLangURI.description: Clause 6.1.4 and Annex B.3. Language-tagged URI (multilingual pointer).

MultiLangURIs.description: Clause 6.1.4: a sequence of multilingual pointers; an 'en' entry is required (see MultiLangStrings).

LanguageTag.description: IETF RFC 5646 language tag (clause 6.1.4, Annex B.1). The text requires language codes in lower case but Table B.1 uses 'bg-Latn' and 'el-Latn', so the primary language subtag must be lower case and the script subtag may be title case.

PlainText.description: Annex B.2: non-empty text with no leading UCS signature (3), no control characters (4), no private-use characters from the BMP zone E000-F8FF or planes 0F and 10 (5), and no Tag Characters U+E0000-E007F (6).

DateTime.description: Clause 6.1.3. ISO 8601 UTC date-time, seconds without fraction, 'Z' designator.

CountryCode.description: Clause 6.1.5. Upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (UK for United Kingdom, EL for Greece, EU for the European Union) or a regional/multi-state code such as AP or ASIA. GB and GR are excluded: a) replaces them, and b)/c) codes may not conflict with a).

Base64.description: Base64 (IETF RFC 4648, clause 4) without line breaks: groups of 4 characters, the last one padded with '=' or '=='.
